card.name: Linking words before vitamin names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, including, such as, include, and the, right before a vitamin name or list (vitamins A, D, E, K). It also fires partway through the word hypervitaminosis.

modes.label: Lead-in to a vitamin list
modes.description: A word like include, including or such as that introduces the fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E and K.
modes.example: FSV<< include>> vitamins A, D, E, and

modes.label: Link inside a vitamin phrase
modes.description: A word like of, the, other or specifically that sits just before the word vitamin.

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word is vitamin or vitamins.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before the word vitamin is expected.
